Both Alex Roldan and Danny Musovski will be questionable for the Sounders on Thursday, with the former recovering from a calf strain and the latter from a head injury.

A knee problem will likely keep Nikola Petkovic out as well, while Yeimar Gomez Andrade has a sore hamstring and Pedro de la Vega is doubtful with a quad issue. [...] In 2026, the Sounders lost four more home games (five) than the year before, though they have only lost one playoff match at Lumen Field this decade in normal time, with Los Angeles FC blanking them 1-0 in 2023.

This will be the first time they compete in the Wild Card Round, with the Rave Green winning their first post-season home outing in 2025.

The Sounders are unbeaten in their last four MLS home games versus Real Salt Lake, collecting a clean sheet on three of those occasions. [...] Sergi Solans and Booth found the back of the net early versus the Galaxy, while an own goal from Luc de Fougerolles led to some anxious moments in the second half before the final whistle blew.

data.content:
Andrew Thomas has played every minute of the last five matches, so he earns the starting place. Ragen and Kossa-Rienzi form the most experienced central pairing in the back line. Cristian Roldán anchors the midfield, and Rusnák and Gomez provide the creativity behind Joveljić. Seattle line up in a 4-2-3-1. Joveljić has nine shots in the recent run, so he is the main focal point to watch.

### Real Salt Lake possible starting eleven [...] Rafael has been the regular keeper for Salt Lake, and he has not missed a minute in the recent matches. De Fougerolles and Sanabria give the back line its strongest combination. Spierings and Caliskan control the central midfield, while Lobjanidze brings energy from the left. Guilavogui can operate wide in the attacking line. Salt Lake also line up in a 4-2-3-1, and Solans should lead the attack after scoring three times in recent matches. [...] Real Salt Lake. ## TipsGG Match Prediction

We predict Real Salt Lake to avoid defeat in a low-scoring match. Their recent form, with four wins in six, outweighs Seattle’s struggles over the last month. Seattle have the home advantage and the better possession numbers, but they have scored only five goals across their last five matches.
